Content.description: A message body (§5.3, Content formats). Every provider accepts text/plain and text/markdown (CommonMark; raw HTML is shown as text); text/html is optional and rendered only through the §5.3 allow-list sanitizer. A body places the message's own attachments inline with attachment:<id> references.

MessageCreate.description: Body that creates a channel message (§7.1): the data of the WS message.create command (which adds groupId and channelId) and the body of POST /api/groups/{groupId}/channels/{channelId}/messages. The provider sets id, author, createdAt and permissions.

clientMessageId.description: Client-chosen idempotency key: (author, channelId, clientMessageId) is idempotent (§7.1).

type.description: Message type (§5.3); omitted means message. Gated by the channel's post:<type> permission (§5.2.1).

attachments.description: Attachments as returned by POST /api/media (§5.8); omitted means [].

reference.description: A reply's parent (§7.2): type MUST be reply (anything else is 400), and id MUST name a message in the same channel. Only such a valid reply satisfies replyOnly / replyOnlyTo (§5.2.1).

mentions.description: Actors the message mentions, set by the author's client (§5.3). When present it is authoritative for mention notifications (§10.1); when absent, mentions are parsed from the text.

title.description: Article title, plain text (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types. When absent, the body's first level-1 heading is the title.

summary.description: Article summary, plain text (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types.

cover.description: Article cover: the id of one of the message's own attachments, which SHOULD be image/* (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types.

MessageUpdate.description: Body of an edit (§7.1): the data of the WS message.update command (which adds groupId, channelId and messageId) and the body of PATCH .../messages/{messageId}. Each field present replaces the stored value; absent fields are unchanged; at least one is required. type, reference and metadata cannot be edited.

attachments.description: Replaces the attachments array in full; checked as on create (§5.8).

tags.description: Replaces the tags array in full.

mentions.description: Replaces the mentions array in full (§5.3).

title.description: Article title (§5.3); null removes it. Ignored on other types.

summary.description: Article summary (§5.3); null removes it. Ignored on other types.

cover.description: Article cover attachment id (§5.3); null removes it. It MUST name one of the message's attachments after the edit. Ignored on other types.

clientMessageId.description: Echo of the clientMessageId the create carried (§7.1, §7.4). It MUST be present on the author's copies of message.created, live or replayed by subscribe.since, and on the response to a create, first or duplicate; elsewhere a provider MAY include or omit it.

mentions.description: Actors the message mentions, set by the author's client (§5.3). When present it is authoritative for mention notifications (§10.1); when absent, mentions are parsed from the text.

title.description: Article title, plain text (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types. When absent, the body's first level-1 heading is the title.

summary.description: Article summary, plain text (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types.

cover.description: Article cover: the id of one of the message's own attachments, which SHOULD be image/* (§5.3). Defined only for type article; ignored on other types.

replyCount.description: Advisory, non-authoritative count of messages whose reference.id is this message (§7.2). Clients MUST NOT rely on it for correctness.

editedAt.description: Set when the message has been edited (§7.1).

deletedAt.description: Set when the message is a tombstone: content is cleared and the id is retained (§7.1).

TimelineItem.description: Union of message-like objects present in timelines.
